name: 果系绞花纯棉儿童连裤袜款
description: 果系配色绞花针织、纯棉亲肤透气、秋冬季保暖儿童连裤袜

styleLock.backgroundSystem: warm off-white #FAF7F2 and cream matte surfaces for editorial shots, pure white #FFFFFF for packshot info cards, periwinkle #7C87B5 reserved for the closing panel
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft warm directional daylight-style key (front-left or side), gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte magazine pages, soft fur rug, neutral matte board
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines only, Chinese text wrapped in 「」, charcoal #2D2D2D as the default text color
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons inside thin gold circle outlines #C9862B, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable gentle 3/4 and overhead product angles, consistent knit-texture rendering, centered stable placement
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft warm knitwear e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm off-white background #FAF7F2, charcoal text #2D2D2D, periwinkle blue-grey accent #7C87B5 and honey gold secondary accent #C9862B; soft warm directional daylight-style lighting with gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent rounded rectangular info cards and labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean editorial product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏用暖调平铺加短标题一眼建立柔软针织的第一印象，赢得点击
shots.camera: top-down 90-degree overhead flat lay, full product visible
shots.lighting: soft warm daylight-style key from the upper left, gentle fill, soft contact shadows
shots.background: open matte magazine pages on a warm off-white desk #FAF7F2
shots.props: one open matte magazine and a hint of dried botanical at the frame corner, not covering the product
shots.textZone: top-center short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D around 40pt set above the flat lay
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce hero flat lay of {product}, softly folded in a relaxed diagonal arrangement on open matte magazine pages, photographed from a top-down 90-degree overhead angle, full product visible and filling 60-70% of the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft warm daylight from the upper left, gentle fill, soft contact shadows. Background warm off-white desk #FAF7F2. A short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D around 40pt sits top-center above the flat lay; headline, magazine pages and folded tights lock into one complete balanced hero composition with natural breathing margins. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand logo, no watermark, no dense body text, no hands, no props covering the product, no cut-off edges.

shots.lighting: soft warm key light from the left, soft contact shadow
shots.props: one thin-line icon beside the headline
shots.textZone: upper left short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D around 40pt plus one thin-line icon in #C9862B
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product shown at a slight 3/4 hero angle on the lower right, filling 50-60% of the frame. The upper left carries one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D around 40pt and one thin-line icon in #C9862B; headline, icon and product lock into one balanced hero layout. Background cream matte board #F5EFE0, soft warm key light from the left, soft contact shadow. shots.intent: 用 2×3 细线圈图标墙快速罗列产品理由点，信息密度高但易扫读

shots.textZone: each cell one short label 「{callout_1}」 to 「{callout_6}」 in #2D2D2D with one small sub-line

Right panel: {product} neatly laid in soft warm directional light with subtle fresh airflow lines conveying breathability, one short label 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The knit detail fills 55-60% of the frame, margins minimal because the texture is the whole point of the screen. Negative: no blurry subject, no fabricated pattern change, no extra text, no watermark, no props.

provenance.notes: 源为 12 片详情页长图切片（面板 800×1200）。主产品判定：首图与复现图均为浅果系绞花针织连裤袜平铺，场景图为幼儿下肢上脚（无面部），判定为女童针织连裤袜；源文件夹名「女装」不作依据，按 taxonomy 归为 母婴/童装。已剥离：虚构数据（1999 年、30 年、60+、200+、65%、GB 执行标准、商品型号）、二维码促销贴、批发市场与发货色差等填充文案、拼音标语；模特仅保留无面部下肢角色；原文案全部改为 {callout}/{selling_point} 文案槽；中筒袜与成人素色运动袜照片判定为无关素材，未纳入主产品。
